letters.fact: Apples grow on trees and come in red, green, and yellow — a great first thing to color in bright colors.
A ball is round like the belly of a lowercase b, so it is an easy word to remember while you color.
The letter C is an open curve, a bit like a cat curling up for a nap.
D is for Dog — try coloring the outline brown, black, or spotted like a real puppy.
An elephant is the biggest land animal, and E is one of the most common letters you will see in words.
F is for Fish — color the letter in blues and greens like water, or bright orange like a goldfish.
G is for Goat, and goats love to climb — this letter is a fun one to color for a farm-animal theme.
The letter H has two tall lines and a bridge in the middle, a little like the frame of a house.
I is for Igloo — color this one with cool icy blues and whites for a wintry look.
J has a little hook at the bottom, a bit like the trailing arms of a jellyfish.
K is for Kite — color the letter in every color of the rainbow like a kite flying in the sky.
L is for Lion — a golden-yellow letter to color, just like a lion's big fluffy mane.
M has two pointy peaks, a little like a monkey's ears — one of the most searched letters to color.
N is for Nest — color it in warm brown twig colors, and maybe add a few eggs of your own.
O is a perfect circle, easy to color inside, and O is for Owl — a friendly bird that says hoot.
P is for Penguin — color the letter black and white just like a real penguin.
Q is a round O with a little tail — color it gold and purple fit for a queen.
R is for Rabbit — a soft, hoppy animal, so try gentle grays, browns, and whites.
S curves like a wiggly snake, and S is for Sun — one of the most popular letters to color in bright yellow.
T is for Tiger — color the letter orange with black stripes, just like a real tiger.
U is shaped like a cup or a smile, and U is for Umbrella — perfect for rainy-day rainbow colors.
V is a sharp point at the bottom, a bit like the pointed shape of a violin.
W looks like waves in the ocean, and W is for Whale — the biggest animal in the sea.
X makes a criss-cross shape — color a xylophone's bars in a different color for each line.
Y branches into two arms like a slingshot, and Y is for Yak — a big, shaggy mountain animal.
Z zig-zags across the page, and Z is for Zebra — color it with bold black-and-white stripes.
